formal_statement: ∃ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin 13 → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ gates.length ≤ 38 ∧ (∀ (w : Fin 13) (x : Fin 13 → Bool), 9 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin 13 => x i = true)).card → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ (({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)).image (fun u => u + w)), x v = true))
plain_statement: Take 13 inputs numbered mod 13 and the 13 lines {0, 1, 3, 9} + w mod 13. Some single list of at most 38 AND and OR gates, each reading at most two wires, has for each line w an output wire equal to the OR of the inputs on that line on every input with at least 9 true coordinates.
title: Plane of order 3, heavy inputs: some list of at most 38 AND and OR gates of fan-in at most two is right on all 13 line-ORs at inputs with at least 9 true points
